'''Bork''' is a big [[Bandos]]ian [[ork]] who is accompanied by the [[Smorks]]. They are one of the bosses in [[The Fractured Archive]] raid. During a given raid of The Fractured Archive, players can choose to fight either Bork and the Smorks or [[Ezekiel]] as the second boss encounter.

==Trivia==
[[File:Bork (2008) concept art.png|thumb|Bork's original concept art, from 2008.]]
* Bork is a portmanteau of the words "big" and "ork".
* In ''RuneScape 2'', {{RSL|Bork}} originally appeared as the repeatable final boss of the {{RSL|The Hunt for Surok (miniquest)|Chaos Tunnels: The Hunt for Surok}} miniquest, released on [[4 March]] 2008, where he was recruited by [[Surok Magis]] to defeat the player. Fighting Bork in this miniquest was originally a requirement for [[While Guthix Sleeps]], while in ''Old School'', he can only be fought afterwards.
** In ''RuneScape 2'', he was accompanied by {{RSL|Ork legion}}s, which may be the inspiration for the Smorks, which is a group of miniature goblins.
** In ''RuneScape 3'', Bork appears in the {{RSL|The Mighty Fall}} quest, released on 2 June 2014. There, he appears as the champion of the Orks in a Bandosian tournament, and is defeated by [[General Graardor]] in the second round.
